details:
Description

I recently purchased the wind customization (and the other free) and it got added to my vrchat account. Now, i let my besty do the same exact thing, i logged off vrchat but not my steam account, he logged in using his vrchat account to purchase those filters and add to his profile. Exprected behavoir: he could get (for free) the (free) customizations, then add to his profile. What happened: he couldn't buy it, saying he had them already, he couldn't add to his profile sayng there was an error. 

He had to log off my steam, log to his steam and log with his vrchat account to purchase

Reproduction Steps

Log on Person A's steam account.

Log on vrchat using the A's steam account.

Buy a customization on A's account

Log off A's account using "switch account"

Log with Person B's vrchat account WHILE the game is being run as A's steam account

Attempt to purchase anything using B but purchased on A account or attempt to equip anything purchased on A but not on B

Details

- Category: Other

- Frequency: Always
